# GiftVibe

GiftVibe is a Sri Lankan online gifting catalog for curated gifts, flowers, sweet treats, gift boxes and celebration combos.

## Primary pages

- [Gift catalog](https://giftvibelk.lk/shop): Browse all active gifts and product categories.
- [Gift combos](https://giftvibelk.lk/combos): Browse curated multi-product celebration combos.
- [Gifting services](https://giftvibelk.lk/services): Personal, celebration and corporate gifting services.
- [Gift ideas blog](https://giftvibelk.lk/blog): Helpful gifting guides and occasion ideas.
- [Customer reviews](https://giftvibelk.lk/reviews): Read verified customer experiences.
- [Live machine-readable catalog](https://giftvibelk.lk/catalog.php): Current database products with descriptions, categories, prices and canonical URLs.
- [About GiftVibe](https://giftvibelk.lk/about): Brand and service information.
- [Contact GiftVibe](https://giftvibelk.lk/contact): Customer support and gifting enquiries.

Only active products in the live catalog should be treated as currently available.
